notes.title: Chaotic Conundrum – The Sampler Platter Is On The Way!
notes.content:
The Sampler Platter is ON THE WAY!


Hello everyone! Thank you for a whole year of support on the game! We are glad to announce we have been hard at work on a taste test for you all to try out! THE SAMPLER PLATTER! Check out the trailer below for a first look:



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/dL563q1Tp2o"][/dynamiclink]

We have also updated the Steam store page to feature an updated description, new screenshots, and the aforementioned trailer, so check it out if you want!



Thank you, from the bottom of our hearts, for sticking with us for one year on our journey so far. We hope you'll join us for whatever twists and turns this journey will take us on. We also apologize for showing very little progress of the game, our goal is to be much more transparent about development through devlogs or teasers.



Anyway, thank you so much for reading... and we'll catch you on the flipside.



-Fernando Arosemena, lead developer of Chaotic Conundrum and director at WET BAGELS

notes.title: Chaotic Conundrum: Summer 2025 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thanks for sticking with us and keeping things going as we've surpassed 200 wishlists! The entire team is extremely grateful for all of you following the project.
But we've been hard at work, and want to show you what's on the menu for today!

OFFICIAL MERCH IS NOW AVAILABLE!

That's right, thanks to Fourthwall we now have Chaotic Conundrum shirts, posters, and even a hat with original designs from yours truly! We hope you enjoy our first wave and stay tuned for more merch in the future.

STEAM PAGE OVERHAUL

We've noticed our Steam page has become a bit outdated. We've made great efforts to redesign all of the assets for the page, as well as provide all-new screenshots and descriptions! Have a look around, will ya?

AND MORE...?

We're working on a lot of things for you guys, such as an official Wet Bagels Website! It's still in the works but set to release soon!
And of course, the big guns...

Officially announcing...
CHAOTIC CONUNDRUM - THE SAMPLER PLATTER

A demo of the game is now in the works! Set to feature multiple levels from the game's prologue and first world, Industry Outskirts Zone! We currently cannot confirm a release date, however, we will be posting teasers more often than not, so be sure to stay tuned.

That's it for now! We hope you stay tuned to what we're cooking.

- Fernando Arosemena, lead developer of Chaotic Conundrum and director at WET BAGELS

notes.title: A Giga-Boy Christmas
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Happy holidays!

My friends and I have been working on a small little surprise for you guys following the game - a song sung by none other than Giga-Boy himself.
https://youtu.be/FJ0cZIAFBg4?si=oWmVleQxgkdRHq4x 
He regrets ever signing up for this, but just remember YOU guys made it possible, because...

We have surpassed 100 wishlists!! Thank you so much for your support and we can't wait to bring you a fine-cooked meal.

Anyway, that's about it! See you all in 2025 - big things are on the way!

- Fernando Arosemena, creator and lead developer
